input.query: SELECT platform, doc_type, SUM(n_decisions) n_decisions, SUM(n_approved) n_approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-15' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY approval_rate

SELECT month, platform, doc_type, reject_reason, SUM(n_rejections) n FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE month >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY month, platform, doc_type, n DESC

SELECT platform, doc_type, kyc_app_version, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) approval_rate FROM dim_users WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-15' AND DATE '2025-12-15' AND is_doc_submitted GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
